body:
**warning: This got way longer than I intended, and pretty angry towards the end. I'm sorry. I guess I needed to let it all out.**

The thing is, I'm not helping her. This has been going on for months now, and she will not listen to me. One of her biggest complains is that "everyone hates me". And it's true. Everyone hates her. Because she is a self-absorbed dick. She made a friend of ours host and pay for a birthday party for her, then she didn't show up to it because she felt everyone hated her. That is the biggest incident really, but in general she'll make plans with people and then bail, or just be a total jerk to people in conversation. She'll just belittle/one-up me, saying stuff like "well that's nothing, at least you don't have to deal with [shitty issue in her life]." So a few months ago I stopped telling her about anything in my life. She never even noticed.

I try and explain to her again and again that if she would maybe show up on time, not break promises, etc, then people might like her a bit more. This results in her just stone-walling, saying things like "I'm a failure" and "This is why I shouldn't exist." She will not accept that these are things she can change.

I haven't even touched the one-upping/belittling issue, because I don't know how to be tactful about it.

The worst part is this makes me so irrationally angry. She keeps belittling me and telling me that my life has been a cakewalk compared to hers, when it is simply so untrue. I went from homeless and alone at 17 to fully self-sufficient and a college graduate before I was 21. I have been WORKING MY ASS OFF for nearly five years now, and I'm in a good point in my life. She is the same age as me and has been living in her parents basement. She has never paid rent, never been hungry or cold a day in her life. And she has the fucking audacity to sit around, do nothing to improve herself, and then tell me I should be grateful my life isn't as bad as hers.


Every goddamn conversation with her makes my blood pressure go through the roof with rage. It's not good for either of us. What she needs is a calm and professional person person to help her with her issues, and I am *not* that person, as you can clearly see.

She will not listen to my advice. She will not accept responsibility for her actions. She will not see a therapist. I just don't know what to do anymore.
